changes.title: Healing confirmation
changes.text: Identified Healing potions can require confirmation at a saved HP threshold from 0% to 100%; the default remains one-tap use.

changes.title: Healing preference controls
changes.text: APD Settings offers a native percentage slider with explicit Save and Cancel, plus an Off option.

changes.title: Compressed-statistics memory
changes.text: Decoding statistics series reuses its step buffer instead of allocating a second array for every column.

changes.title: Healing regression coverage
changes.text: Tested every percentage boundary, unidentified bypass and persistence, with real Android cancellation, consumption and settings controls.

changes.title: Statistics series coverage
changes.text: Added signed-long extremes and delta-overflow roundtrips and recorded an actual decoder allocation comparison.

changes.title: Build evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST97's successful verification and delivery, this batch's checks and its remaining limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added optional healing confirmation without changing healing effects or normal drinking costs. I also reduced temporary memory use when reading compressed statistics.
